definitions.explanation: Lasting forever or for an indefinitely long time; not temporary.

examples.japanese: {永久的|えいきゅうてき}な{解決策|かいけつさく}を{探|さが}している。
examples.english: We're looking for a permanent solution.

examples.japanese: {永久的|えいきゅうてき}に{保存|ほぞん}される{記録|きろく}だ。
examples.english: It's a record that will be preserved permanently.

examples.japanese: {永久的|えいきゅうてき}な{平和|へいわ}を{願|ねが}う。

notes:
{永久的|えいきゅうてき} is a na-adjective meaning permanent, eternal, or everlasting.

WORD FORMATION:
{永久|えいきゅう} (eternity, permanence) + {的|てき} (adjectival suffix)

FORMS:
- Adverbial: {永久的|えいきゅうてき}に (permanently)
- Noun modifier: {永久的|えいきゅうてき}な + noun

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {永久的|えいきゅうてき}な{解決|かいけつ}: permanent solution
- {永久的|えいきゅうてき}に{保存|ほぞん}する: to preserve permanently
- {永久的|えいきゅうてき}な{影響|えいきょう}: lasting impact

SIMILAR/CONTRASTING:
- {一時的|いちじてき}: temporary (opposite)
- {恒久的|こうきゅうてき}: permanent (formal synonym)
- {永遠|えいえん}: eternal, forever (noun/na-adjective)
